title: Vanguard vs Fidelity
shortAnswer: Vanguard pioneered low-cost index investing and manages $8T+ in assets with the world's lowest average expense ratios. Fidelity offers zero expense ratio index funds, better account features, a wider range of services, and superior trading platforms.
verdict: Both are excellent. Fidelity edges out for overall features and usability. Vanguard remains the gold standard for buy-and-hold index investors.

lines.hook: Vanguard invented the index fund. Fidelity just made it free.
lines.tape: One built the philosophy. The other built the better product around it.
rounds: Fidelity manages 12 trillion dollars. Vanguard's 8 trillion is no longer the ceiling.
Vanguard's 0.03 percent was the record. Fidelity charges literally nothing.
Vanguard's platform gets you in and out. Active Trader Pro is a cockpit.
FZROX and FZILX cost zero forever. Vanguard has no answer to that.
Both answer the phone. Fidelity answers it faster and knows more.
lines.verdict: Fidelity sweeps it 5-0. Choose Vanguard if you only ever buy and hold.

youtubeTitle: Vanguard vs Fidelity: Which Broker Actually Wins?
youtubeDescription:
A head-to-head breakdown of Vanguard and Fidelity across assets under management, expense ratios, trading platforms, zero-fee index funds and customer service. Fidelity takes every round on paper, but Vanguard still has a case for pure buy-and-hold index investors. Here's who should pick which.

Figures accurate as of August 2026. Statistics change over time — see the full, maintained comparison at https://www.aversusb.net/compare/vanguard-vs-fidelity
